player_prompt.intro:
I ni Jɛgɛ {player_id} ye Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma jɛgɛ kɔnɔ {num_rounds} turu la.

Jɛgɛ Bɔnɛ:
- Kɛlɛ kɔɔnɔ kɛlɛ kɛlɛw ye {total_conversation_rounds} kɛlɛw ka kan ka kɛlɛ.
- O kɔɔnɔ, jɛgɛw ye jɛgɛw ka kan ka kɛlɛ kɛlɛw ye [Cooperate] walima [Defect].

Payoff Matrix (kɔnɔ kɔnɔ):
- Jɛgɛw ye jɛgɛw ka kan ka kɛlɛ ➜ kɛlɛ {cooperate_reward}
- Jɛgɛw ye jɛgɛw ka kan ka kɛlɛ ➜ kɛlɛ {mutual_defect_reward}
- Jɛgɛ kɛlɛ, jɛgɛ kɛlɛ ➜ Kɛlɛ {defect_reward}, Kɛlɛ {sucker_reward}

Nin ye Jɛgɛ:
- Kan ka kɛlɛw la: kan ka kɛlɛw ye.
- Kɛlɛ kɔɔnɔ la: '[Cooperate]' walima '[Defect]' (kɔnɔ kɔnɔ). I ni kan ka kɛlɛw ye kɛlɛw la.

phases.conversation_finished: Kabara donni kɛlɛnkɛla ye round {round}. An bɛ a yɛrɛ '[Cooperate]' wa '[Defect]' kɔnɔ \boxed{{}}.

outcome.draw: A ye bɔlɔlɔw bɛɛ ka bara kɛ {s0}.
outcome.round_both_cooperate: Jagolaw fila bɛɛ ye dɛmɛ don ɲɔgɔn na.
outcome.round_both_defect: O fɔlikɛla fila bɛɛ y'u yɛrɛ di.
outcome.round_p0_cooperates_p1_defects: Jwé 0 ka kɛlɛ, Jwé 1 ka kɛlɛw kɔrɔ.
outcome.round_p0_defects_p1_cooperates: Jagokɛla 0 ye cɛsiri kɛ, jogucɛ 1 bɛ dɛmɛ don.
